name: Joachim Stanisław Brudziński - Proposition de décision
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section IX – European Data Protection Supervisor
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European Data Protection Supervisor spent its 2023 budget, which was about 22.7 million euros. The report is not a law. It gives the supervisor clearance and lists requests: make mission costs public again, explain spending on travel, fill senior jobs with more women, join the EU Transparency Register, report burnout cases yearly, and adopt a recognised environmental scheme. Parliament also asks for more money to cover the supervisor's growing tasks.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. The supervisor is cleared for 2023 and asked to improve transparency and reporting.
- **Who it affects:** The European Data Protection Supervisor, its staff, and the EU bodies it oversees.
- **What happens next:** The supervisor must report back to Parliament on the requests, and budget talks will consider its workload.
